records.title: G-SalAlignMamba: Geometry-Aware Vision Mamba for Dual-Modal Salient Object Detection
records.reason: The IJCAI primary PDF describes G-SalAlignMamba for RGB-D/RGB-T salient-object detection. It reports 30.41 FPS and 83.80M parameters and addresses geometric alignment, sparse foreground salience, and image decoder boundaries. These are visual segmentation/detection mechanisms; there is no LLM or language-serving evaluation.

records.title: Learning Heterogeneous Global Local Frequency Dependencies in Diffusion-Based Image Compression
records.reason: The IJCAI primary PDF describes FMDiff for diffusion-based image compression, with Fourier/Mamba branches for local/global image-frequency dependencies. Ablations compare magnitude/phase and Mamba variants; conclusion reports image distortion/perceptual tradeoffs. It addresses image compression and reconstruction, not LLM inference or KV/serving efficiency.

records.title: AnoMamba: Aligning Reconstruction with Time Series Anomaly Detection via Selective Global Dependency Modeling
records.reason: The IJCAI primary PDF describes AnoMamba for univariate and multivariate time-series anomaly detection. It uses patch embedding and global step-size reweighting; experiments use eight anomaly-detection benchmarks and report detection metrics plus efficiency. The inference operation is task-specific reconstruction scoring, with no language/LLM inference or serving evaluation.

records.title: Towards Efficient and Effective Unimodal Trajectory Representation Learning: A Simple Yet Powerful Approach
records.reason: The IJCAI primary PDF describes SimTRL, a bidirectional Mamba trajectory encoder for road-network trajectory representation. Experiments report 11.2x pre-training speedup against multimodal comparison and lower training time, while the efficiency table measures epochs and seconds per epoch. The claimed gain is trajectory-model pre-training, not LLM inference or serving.
